scripts.prebuild: pnpm run check:runtime && node scripts/bootstrap-sati-config.mjs && pnpm --filter edgeclaw-memory-core build
scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/extension/plugins/builtin','dist/src/extension/plugins/builtin',{recursive:true})" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/knowledge/patent/ipc-standards.yaml','dist/src/knowledge/patent/ipc-standards.yaml')" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/patent/figure/symbols/electrical-symbols.yaml','dist/src/patent/figure/symbols/electrical-symbols.yaml')" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/knowledge/patent/wiki','dist/src/knowledge/patent/wiki',{recursive:true})" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/methodology/runtime/components/data','dist/src/methodology/runtime/components/data',{recursive:true})" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('assets/templates/patent','dist/assets/templates/patent',{recursive:true})" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('assets/patent','dist/assets/patent',{recursive:true})"
scripts.server: npm run check:runtime && tsx src/cli/sati.ts server
scripts.server:built: npm run check:runtime && node dist/src/cli/sati.js server
scripts.predev: npm run check:runtime && node scripts/bootstrap-sati-config.mjs && pnpm --filter edgeclaw-memory-core build
scripts.test:patent-eval: npm run build && node scripts/patent-eval.mjs --mode graph --suite tests/patent/benchmark/fixtures/patent-exam-real-a22.json --max-cases 1
scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts apps/desktop && pnpm --filter sati-ui lint && pnpm check:event-matrix
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src tests scripts apps/desktop --fix && pnpm --filter sati-ui lint:fix
